t: You're looking at numbers 24 to 42 Norfolk Square, a building in Westminster in the W2 postcode, near Paddington. The one person tied to it in our records is Alice Pilling McKeand, who died here in 1894 at the age of forty-two or forty-three. She was born in 1851 and appears in the peerage records. Beyond that, little is recorded, so this is simply a place where one Victorian woman's life came to its end.
